mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requests (title, content, status, priority, requester_id, assignee_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{requesterId}, #{assigneeId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.request_id AS requestId, r.title AS title, r.content AS content, r.status AS status, r.priority AS priority, r.requester_id AS requesterId, requester.name AS requesterName, assignee.name AS assigneeName, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM requests r JOIN users requester ON r.requester_id = requester.user_id LEFT JOIN users assignee ON r.assignee_id = assignee.user_id WHERE r.request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: UPDATE requests SET status = #{status}, assignee_id = COALESCE(assignee_id, #{assigneeId}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
